_comment: Webhook tools for the ElevenLabs agent. Replace https://YOUR-TUNNEL.trycloudflare.com with the URL start.sh prints. Each tool body is the tool_config for POST /v1/convai/tools.

tools.name: medication_status
tools.description: Check if medicine is due right now, when it was last taken, and the next scheduled time. Use when they ask 'did I take my pills?' or about their medicine.

tools.name: log_medication
tools.description: Record that the person just took their medicine (turns the red light off). Use only when they clearly say they took it.

tools.name: log_mood
tools.description: Save how the person feels, after they tell you. Call it once per conversation, and again if their mood clearly changes.

mood.description: One or two words, e.g. happy, calm, tired, lonely, anxious, sad, in pain

score.description: 1 = very bad, 2 = bad, 3 = okay, 4 = good, 5 = very good

note.description: Short note in their own words, e.g. 'misses her daughter'

tools.name: room
tools.description: Get the current room temperature and humidity from the sensor in the device.

tools.name: show_on_screen
tools.description: Show a short reminder (max ~8 words) on the device's small screen, e.g. 'Call Anna at 5'.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to one of the person's contacts, e.g. 'send a text to Gustav saying I'll be late'. Call it as soon as you know who to send it to and what to say.

recipient.description: Who the message is for, e.g. Gustav

message.description: The message text, in the person's own words
